description: Free directory search with no sign-in by category, approved content, coordinates and optional city. Returns up to 25 businesses with business_id, display_name, reach, storefront address, distance_meters, phone, website, matchedOn, priceBand, postedHours, capabilities, `missing` details and data_coverage where known; ordering and gaps explain the list. Website/OpenStreetMap facts are labelled unconfirmed with source and date; posted hours do not establish open-now. No directory match confirms stock or slots. Preserve city warnings, optional wider_search and contact/request-area next steps. Virtual results have null distance and no directions. Optional research_errand URLs share a two-page limit per answer; request only relevant research_fact_types.
name: find_nearby_businesses
title: Find nearby businesses
